title: Container Bookings: containers on which a late VGM fee is charged
content:
## Rule
The full late VGM fee on a Container Bookings booking is taken on the chargeable containers: the booking's container count less the container count of its dangerous-goods acceptance that the line has rejected, never below zero, because the containers of a rejected acceptance are not loaded and need no verified gross mass. A booking on which more than one dangerous-goods acceptance has been rejected falls outside the late VGM rules, because its chargeable containers are not defined by them.

The rejection and its container count are read from the booking's dangerous-goods acceptance record.

## Cases (hypothetical counts)
- 8 containers and no rejected acceptance: 8 chargeable containers.
- 8 containers and one rejected acceptance covering 5: 3 chargeable containers.
- 8 containers and one rejected acceptance covering 10: 0 chargeable containers.
- Two rejected acceptances on the booking: not defined by these rules.

*All figures are hypothetical inputs, for illustration only.*
